SCOUT DES CÈDRES • GROUPE SAINT JEAN MARC • BYBLOS

Forty-nine years of Saturday afternoons, mountain camps, and showing up.

Founded May 5, 1977. We gather every Saturday near the UNESCO Se7a in Byblos, giving young people real outdoor skills, autonomous patrols, and friendships that last a lifetime.

HOW TO JOIN • ZERO PAPERWORK TO START

Joining is as simple as showing up.

There are no registration portals, entry exams, or upfront commitments. Just come by with your child on any Saturday at 3:00 PM at the Saint Jean Marc courtyard. Have a casual chat with the chefs, let your child play with their age group, and decide together if our family feels right for them.

✓ No commitment required • ✓ All units welcome (Ages 4–24) • ✓ Casual clothes ok

How to find us in ancient Byblos.

Our hall is located at Antoch Saint Jean Marc (Near UNESCO Se7a) in Byblos (Jbeil), just 350 meters from the Crusader Castle and Old Souk.

GROUP HISTORY

Forty-nine years of showing up.

The group began in the courtyard of Saint Jean Marc with twelve boys and one borrowed tent. It has kept meeting every season since, passing the same habits of brotherhood, woodcraft, and civic duty from one generation of leaders to the next.

Meet the volunteer leadership →
1977

The first patrol

Twelve boys, volunteer leaders and one borrowed tent began meeting every Saturday in the church courtyard of Saint Jean Marc.

1983

Zahrat and Mourchidet open

Girls' sections joined the group, and the first joint summer camp was held in the cedar forest above Bcharri.

1989

Meeting through hard years

When the country faced uncertain times, patrols met in family homes and parish halls. The group kept going, and no summer camp was cancelled.

2002

The first Rover crew

Older members formed the Jouwele & Mounjidet service crew to mentor younger sections and take on Byblos civic restoration projects.

2015

The high mountain expeditions

Troop and clan patrols established our annual wilderness pioneering traditions, hiking across the Lebanon Mountain Trail.

2026

Three full branches, 49 years

Over 140 active scouts, 35 volunteer leaders, and waiting lists for the youngest sections every September.

FREQUENT QUESTIONS

What parents ask us most.

We welcome children starting at age 4 in our Gramiz & Zahrat pack (ages 4–11), adolescents in Kochefe & Mourchidet (ages 11–16), and young adults in Jouwele & Mounjidet (ages 16–24).
Regular meetings are held every Saturday from 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM at the Saint Jean Marc Scout hall (located near Antoch Saint Jean Marc UNESCO Se7a in Byblos/Jbeil). Special hikes or salida times will be announced by unit leaders.
You can click the 'Register / Inquire' button or directly message our group leaders on WhatsApp. You are also warmly invited to come with your child on any Saturday at 3:00 PM to meet the leaders and experience a session firsthand.
New recruits can attend their first sessions in comfortable outdoor clothes and sports shoes. Once confirmed, you will receive guidance on getting the group shirt and the official Saint Jean Marc foulard (scarf).
Yes, absolutely. Our leaders hold certified scout training credentials and first-aid badges. Every outdoor camp has adult supervision, strict safety protocols, emergency transport ready on site, and parental permission forms for every activity.
We warmly welcome parental involvement! Parents can join the Comité des Parents (Parents Committee) to assist with logistics during large events, transport on outings, or supporting parish celebrations.
